justification: Product names on 34 files (labels, an email subject) plus a 9-line effect so the address page starts from ?address=. Not Minor: more than 3 substantive files and one user-facing email subject. Not Critical: no data, query or API behaviour changes.

falsifiable_check.command: cd frontend-nextjs && npx jest __tests__/lib/product-names.test.ts && grep -rIl 'Site Report' app components lib; test $? -eq 1
falsifiable_check.fails_when: The retired name Site Report appears anywhere in app, components or lib, Site Facts appears on the address page or marketing shell, or Council Rules appears inside the generated report.
falsifiable_check.observed_red: Both halves seen red. grep: 34 files contained Site Report before the rename, 0 after. Hook: with the latest-selection guard removed, usePropertyAssessment.test.ts fails (Expected BETA, Received ALPHA); with it restored it passes. Jest run locally: 11 suites, 134 tests, exit 0. CI also caught a test pinning the old homepage box target (HeroAddressSearch.test.tsx); updated. Full Jest: 209 suites, 2,565 tests, exit 0.

pre_impl.existing_data: none - labels, one email subject, and a URL query read on page load.
pre_impl.assumption_mismatch: If ?address= is absent or empty the page behaves exactly as before; only a non-empty address with nothing selected triggers handleAddressSelect.
pre_impl.new_vs_existing: Applies to every page view after deploy; no stored data changes.
pre_impl.user_failure_mode: If the address lookup fails the page shows its existing error state, as when a user types the address.

functions.name: AssessmentPage
functions.if_none: no address in the link: nothing happens

functions.name: handleAddressSelect
functions.input: an address string and optional coordinates from the visitor
functions.output: sets property, error and loading state for the newest request only
functions.if_none: an empty address still follows the existing error path

values.if_missing: the page loads empty as before

break_it.scenario: The link carries an address but the user has already chosen another.
break_it.what_happens: It could overwrite the visitor's own choice.
break_it.how: The effect runs once on mount and only when selectedAddress is empty.
break_it.repro: Open /assessment?address=1 Martin Place Sydney, then pick another address in the box.

break_it.scenario: The Your Site Facts email subject changed and a test still pins the old subject.
break_it.what_happens: CI fails on lead-abuse or lead-email tests.
break_it.how: Both tests were updated in the same change to match /Site Facts/i.

break_it.scenario: Someone reintroduces Site Report in new copy.
break_it.what_happens: Two products carry one name again.
break_it.how: product-names.test.ts scans app, components and lib.

break_it.scenario: Two address lookups overlap and the older one answers last.
break_it.what_happens: The older response could replace the newer property.
break_it.how: Each call takes a request number; only the newest may set property, error or loading.

post_merge.manual_verify: Open the preview homepage, type an address in the box and confirm /assessment loads that property.
